name: Cobot Coworking Software
description:
Connect Claude to your Cobot coworking or flex space and manage it in plain language — ask things like "Book the blue meeting room for Jane tomorrow from 10 to 12.", "Which offices will be free next month?" or "Show me all unpaid invoices this month”. 

Once connected, Claude can do things like:

- List bookable resources (rooms, desks, etc.) and check availability
- List and give details about memberships, teams, and visitor contacts
- List and inspect your invoices
- Show which offices or other resources are allocated or free.
- Create or change bookings, optionally on behalf of a member
- View a member's check-in history
- and more

Access is scoped to the spaces you manage in Cobot, with permissions matching what's granted to you in each space.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cobot Coworking Software to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cobot Coworking Software to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cobot.me/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cobot Coworking Software MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cobot Coworking Software lists 22 MCP tools, including check_out, check_resource_availability, create_booking, get_booking, get_contact, get_current_user, get_external_booking, get_invoice, get_membership, get_product, get_team, and list_allocations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cobot Coworking Software?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cobot Coworking Software in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Cobot Coworking Software MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cobot Coworking Software requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cobot Coworking Software is developed by Cobot Coworking Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
